column3: Sri Lanka National Commission
for UNESCO
have the ownership of all research, any material or
data  collected  by  any  person  for  the  purposes  of
this  Act,  and  be  responsible  for  the  protection  of
such research, material or data;
administer  and  coordinate  of  UNESCO  activities
and permit the use of UNESCO approved logo with
UNESCO listed sites and items and activities and
charge fees for such services;
open and maintain, current, savings and deposit or
fixed accounts in any bank or banks and     invest
such funds as are not immediately required for the
purposes of the Commission in such securities as it
may determine;
accept gifts, contributions, grants or donations from
local  or  foreign  sources,  whether  in  cash  or
otherwise,  for  the  purpose  of  discharging  the
functions of the Commission:
Provided that, notwithstanding anything to the
contrary  in  any  other  provisions  of  this  Act,  the
Commission shall obtain prior written approval of
the Department of External Resources in respect of
all foreign grants, gifts or donations;
impose a levy on every visitor to UNESCO heritage
sites  and  biosphere  reserves  and  other  UNESCO
sites  in Sri Lanka, calculated at such rate as may be
fixed  by  the  Minister  in  consultation  with  the
Minister in charge of the subject of Finance;
acquire and hold, take or give on lease, mortgage
or hire, pledge or sell or otherwise dispose of, any
movable or immovable property, for the purpose of
